summary: Frontend-only regression PASS with 1 minor persistence bug. All 8 requested flows verified on mobile viewport (390x844) against the public Expo web preview. Bottom-tab navigation between Device / Flights / Sports / Weather renders every screen without crashes. Device tab shows 'Disconnected' pill and the expected 'Bluetooth runs only in a real device build' info hint. Wi-Fi form accepts SSID + password, password field renders as type='password' (secureTextEntry). Tapping 'Send to Matrix' with no BLE connection shows the info toast 'Connect to the matrix first.' (no crash). Flights: ZIP 28117 resolves to 'Mooresville, NC  ·  35.584, -80.868' via api.zippopotam.us; radius label 25 mi rendered and Slider is present + keyboard-focusable. Sports: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/UFC segmented control works, tapping a team card selects it, UFC segment swaps grid for the 'UFC Fight Night' toggle card. Weather: master toggle flips, Extreme severity radio selects, and location note correctly reflects the ZIP set on the Flights tab ('Alerts for Mooresville, NC'). SYNC FAB is present on all tabs; while disconnected it shows the info toast 'BLE needs a real device build to sync.' No red screens, no unhandled errors. Persistence: after reload, sports.teams (Chiefs) and weather.severity (Extreme) and flights.lat/lon/city/state all rehydrate correctly BUT the ZIP TextInput on the Flights tab renders empty because the local `zip` state is only seeded from `f.zip` at first render (before AsyncStorage hydration completes). The resolved 'Mooresville, NC · ...' still shows, so functional behavior is correct — only the input field's displayed text is wrong. Small design/testability nits noted below.

ui_bugs.issue: After a reload the TextInput on /(tabs)/flights.tsx shows empty (placeholder 28117) even though settings.flights.zip was persisted. Root cause: `const [zip, setZip] = useState(f.zip)` at flights.tsx:21 seeds local state on first render, but MatrixProvider hydrates from AsyncStorage in an effect *after* mount, so the input never picks up the persisted value. Same shape applies to `const [radius_, setRadius] = useState(f.radiusMi)` at flights.tsx:22. Fix: add `useEffect(() => setZip(f.zip), [f.zip])` and `useEffect(() => setRadius(f.radiusMi), [f.radiusMi])`, or gate render on `hydrated` from useMatrix() (index.tsx already does this pattern for lastSsid at index.tsx:43-45).

issues: No testID attributes on any interactive element (Device Wi-Fi inputs, eye toggle, Send to Matrix, ZIP input, Slider, League segmented pills, team cards, severity radio cards, SYNC FAB, tab labels). Made programmatic verification of the password eye toggle impossible — forced fallback to text-based selectors. Recommend testID on: ssid-input, wifi-pass-input, wifi-pass-eye, wifi-send-btn, ble-status-card, zip-input, radius-slider, league-seg-{NFL|NBA|MLB|NHL|UFC}, team-card-{league}-{abbr}, sev-card-{minor|moderate|severe|extreme}, sync-fab.
Password eye toggle Pressable has no accessibilityLabel/role — rendered as a plain <div> in RN-web with role=button count = 0 in DOM, so screen readers get no affordance.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' fires on every render. Emitted from SyncFab.tsx:94-97 (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset) and other Card-style shadows. React Native 0.81+ on web wants boxShadow. Non-blocking cosmetic warning.

Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Coming from SyncFab.tsx:52 (`<View pointerEvents="box-none" …>`) and Toast.tsx (pointerEvents already moved into style, still fires from SyncFab). Move to style: `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none', … }}`. Non-blocking.

Not deprecated but by design will never work in Expo Go / web preview. Codebase already handles this gracefully via isBleSupported() gate and the info hint. NOT A BUG — flagged only so the next agent doesn't re-report it.

action_items: flights.tsx: re-sync local `zip` and `radius_` state to persisted settings after hydration (add useEffect on f.zip / f.radiusMi, or gate render on `hydrated`).
Add testID props to key interactive elements across all 4 tabs + SyncFab + eye toggle so subsequent regressions can assert directly (currently everything relies on text-matching).
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow (RN 0.81+ / RN-Web) and move `pointerEvents` from prop to style in SyncFab.tsx to silence the deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: matrix.tsx exports `hydrated` but no screen actually reads it; both index.tsx and flights.tsx seed local state from `settings` at first render, which is DEFAULT_SETTINGS. index.tsx sidesteps this only for lastSsid via a useEffect; flights.tsx has no equivalent — hence the ZIP hydration bug above.

livePush() in matrix.tsx uses `bleStatus` captured at the time useCallback was created; because updateFlights/updateSports/updateWeather depend on `livePush`, and livePush depends on `bleStatus`, this recreates all three setters on every BLE status change. Fine functionally but causes settingsRef consumers to re-subscribe more than needed. Non-blocking.
Password eye Pressable (index.tsx:193) has no accessibilityLabel/role — not screen-reader accessible and cannot be selected via [role=button] in tests.
SyncFab positions itself using a hardcoded TAB_BAR_HEIGHT = 64; the tab bar in _layout.tsx is also 64, so this couples two files. Prefer reading from a shared constant or via useBottomTabBarHeight().
No error boundary around the tab router — an uncaught render error in any tab would crash the whole app on device.

success_rate.frontend: 13/14 assertions passed (ZIP-input-post-reload assertion failed; functional data still hydrated)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 390x844. There are no testIDs anywhere in the app — tests must rely on placeholder / visible-text selectors. The password eye toggle is a Pressable with no accessibility role in RN-Web; if you need to verify it, click via input's parent element or ask main agent to add testID='wifi-pass-eye'. ZIP geocode takes ~3-5s (cold) via api.zippopotam.us. AsyncStorage key = 'aura_settings_v1'; last SSID key = 'aura_last_ssid'. BLE will always report unsupported on web — do NOT flag it. Deprecation warnings for shadow* and pointerEvents are non-blocking.
rca_of_issue:
Bug: ZIP field empty after reload.
Repro: Enter ZIP 28117 on Flights tab, wait for 'Mooresville, NC ...' to resolve, reload page, revisit Flights tab.
Expected: TextInput shows '28117'.
Actual: TextInput shows placeholder '28117' (empty value); resolved city/coords label still shows correctly.
Root cause: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/flights.tsx line 21, `const [zip, setZip] = useState(f.zip)` captures the value of f.zip at first render. MatrixProvider hydrates from AsyncStorage inside a useEffect (matrix.tsx:139-153) which runs AFTER first render, so `settings.flights.zip` is initially '' when FlightsScreen mounts. When settings later updates, the local `zip` state is not re-synced. index.tsx handles the equivalent scenario for `lastSsid` via `useEffect(() => { if (lastSsid) setSsid(lastSsid); }, [lastSsid])` at index.tsx:43-45; flights.tsx needs the same treatment for both `zip` and `radius_`. Mitigation: (a) add matching useEffects, or (b) `if (!hydrated) return null;` at the top of FlightsScreen and similar tab screens.
